title: DAY 7 — LESSON 2: UNDERSTANDING THE QUALITIES OF AN EXCELLENT ZURA TEAM MEMBER

questions.prompt: What best describes an excellent Zura team member?
options: Someone who combines competence, character, professionalism, accountability and teamwork
Someone who is popular with every colleague
Changing records to conceal an error
Keeping mistakes secret when management is absent

questions.prompt: What should an experienced employee do when introduced to an updated procedure?
options: Review and apply the approved procedure
Accepting blame for every workplace problem
Taking responsibility for your actual duties and contribution
Blaming others whenever something goes wrong

questions.prompt: What does the ZURA EXCELLENCE framework represent?
options: Zero mistakes, Unlimited work, Rapid speed and Authority
